correctness.rationale: For binary Boolean multiplication, support of W_hn occupies residues 0 and 1 mod h. For h>=3, if both factors contain a residue-1 term, their sum forces forbidden residue 2; thus one factor is pure residue 0. For a degree n-b support, convolution with a full width-b window covers Q_n iff its ordered gaps are <=b, counted by c_b(n-b). Pure factors contribute one c_b, mixed factors two independent rows contribute c_b^2, summed over b=1..n. All n>=1 and h>=3; h=2,n=2 yields 5 instead of 4. An independently written support-subset enumerator verified all h=3,4,5 and n=1..5, plus the boundary; finite cases do not prove the universal formula.
